test.argumentDiscoveryLimit: Flat discovery lists methods, not dynamic arguments; argument results are checked for nonemptiness, unique identities, success, and device-summary agreement.

costDiagnostics.interpretation: Separate stable-input phases include their observation overhead; subtracting phases does not isolate LRU bookkeeping

exportNote: Original attachment payload retained except the local Simulator instance name. Receipt/logs remain with the local run; this export contains no local paths or device identifiers. Candidate HEAD is the base commit, with the measured working-tree sources identified by their fingerprints.

measurements.attributedConfiguration: Prebuilt immutable attributed snapshot; font plus bold first 12 UTF-16 units, 3-point line spacing, 0.3 kern
measurements.contentInputs: Short title, multiline paragraph, long text, attributed typography; mixed trace appends semantic variant
